abilities.name: Burrow
abilities.text: If this Unit is Unengaged, it gains or loses the Burrowed Status.

abilities.name: Roachling Infestation
abilities.text: Once Per Game. Resolve the SUMMON (Roachling) effect.

abilities.name: Regeneration
abilities.text: When this Unit becomes Activated, if it has the Burrowed Status, resolve the HEAL (2) effect.

abilities.name: Devastating Charge
abilities.text: Immediately after this Unit completes a successful Charge, resolve the IMPACT (3) 4+ effect.

upgrades.name: Tunneling Claws
upgrades.text: While this Unit has the Burrowed Status, it may perform the Move and Run actions without losing that Status. It may also move through other Units' bases.

upgrades.name: Glial Reconstitution
upgrades.text: This Unit gains BUFF SPEED (1), or BUFF SPEED (2) if the Unit is ON CREEP. (Printed as 1 CP on this card.)

upgrades.name: Burrow Ambush
upgrades.text: When this Unit is nominated to deploy from the Reserves, it may resolve the PLACE (18) effect from the controlling player's Entry Edge. No model may be set Within 10″ of any Enemy model. This Unit's Activation ends.

upgrades.name: Hydriodic Bile
upgrades.text: This Unit's Acid Saliva weapon gains Surge Type: Light, and S Dice: D3+1.
